skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand approaches to climate change, economic mitigation and adaptation.
Analyze urban policies and planning related to climate change.
Apply theories and principles of urban adaptation strategies to specific scenarios.
Work effectively in groups, present and discuss findings.
Independently seek, read and synthesize scientific information from various sources.
Develop critical thinking skills through analysis and discussion.
Demonstrate ability to learn independently and accumulate experience for further studies.
Develop ethical awareness and social responsibility.
